title: Beat Detector MONSTER
tagline: Turn sound waves into light shows that pulse with your favorite music!

phases.instructions: Collect the KY-037 Sound Sensor module, 3x LEDs (Red, Green, Blue), 3x 220-ohm resistors, and jumpers.
verificationCheckpoints: KY-037 microphone sensor with electret capsule ready

phases.instructions: Wire KY-037 power and analog output A0. Wire the 3 LEDs to digital pins 9, 10, 11 with 220-ohm current-limiting resistors.
verificationCheckpoints: KY-037 A0 connected to Arduino Analog Pin A0
LED cathodes all tied to GND rail

phases.instructions: Check that the trimmer screw on the blue box on KY-037 is tuned so the onboard LED stays off in quiet room noise.
verificationCheckpoints: Turn potentiometer screw until onboard LED is just off

phases.instructions: Examine the sketch. We take high-speed analog samples, calculate acoustic deviations from baseline 512, and light up LEDs proportionally to loudness.
phases.codeExplanation:
- abs(raw - 512) measures how far sound pressure waves swing away from silence midpoint (512).
- Moderate sounds (>20) light LED 1.
- Louder claps (>60) light LED 2.
- Peak beats (>120) light all 3 LEDs simultaneously.

phases.instructions: Upload the code, open Serial Plotter, play music near the mic or clap hands, and watch the LEDs pulse with the rhythm!
verificationCheckpoints: LEDs pulse in sync with claps
Quiet room leaves all LEDs off

phases.instructions: Groovy! You built an acoustic sound visualizer and mastered ADC signal processing.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Audio Engineer badge

troubleshooting.symptom: LEDs are permanently ON even when quiet
troubleshooting.solution: Rotate the brass screw on the blue potentiometer counter-clockwise until LEDs turn off.
diagnosticSteps: Use a small screwdriver to turn the blue potentiometer on the microphone module.
Open Serial Monitor to observe live acoustic baseline numbers.

story: Your robot wants to dance! Build an acoustic Beat Detector that samples acoustic pressure waves through a microphone and creates a pulsing light show synced to your clapping or music.
